eventMetadata.context_description: No. 2 seed UConn advanced to the 2026 NCAA national championship with a 71-62 Final Four victory over No. 3 seed Illinois, fending off a late Illini rally behind balanced scoring from Mullins and Reed while disrupting Illinois' efficient offense. Pre-game trader sentiment reflected a razor-thin matchup, with Illinois installed as a 1.5-point favorite after a 7-0 overall and ATS hot streak since mid-February, including tournament triumphs over Houston and Iowa for their sixth Final Four trip. UConn's dynasty pedigree—two-time defending champs seeking a third title in four years—plus head-to-head dominance (2024 Elite Eight and November non-conference wins) fueled competitive implied probabilities amid full health for key players on both sides.
